The '''''Scorpion''-class Intercept Shuttle''' was a model of [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] used by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of the [[Hidden Chain]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. A spacecrafts of this class possessed with light armaments and features variable wing configurations for swift, maneuverable flight in-atmosphere. It carries a 12-person armored [[Squad/Legends|squad]], their gear, a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and a [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]]. [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] can deploy via a ladder in vertical mode, exiting rapidly with [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]].<ref name="Codex" /> 

[[Heta Kol]] acquired several Scorpions from [[Clan Varad]] who had seized them from [[Cindev]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] and stationed them at secret [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]] bases. The [[Hidden Chain]] then employed them in their military operations.<ref name="Codex" />
